in_marathi.name: Tufan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Fierce, Strong, Powerful
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tufan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A powerful and fierce name, derived from the Sanskrit word 'tapa' meaning 'heat' and 'han' meaning 'destroyer'. Tufan represents a brave and victorious warrior who can withstand any adversity and emerge victorious.
